```{r}
transposePCA <- function(data){
rownames(data) <- data[[1]]

data <- data[, -1]

data <- t(data)

return(data)
}

#transposing

gemma_objs <- ls(pattern = "_gemma")
gemma_objs <- gemma_objs[sapply(gemma_objs, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]

for (obj_name in gemma_objs) {
  df <- get(obj_name)
  df <- transposePCA(df)
  assign(obj_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

author_objs <- ls(pattern = "_author")
author_objs <- author_objs[sapply(author_objs, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]

for (obj_name in author_objs) {
  df <- get(obj_name)
  df <- transposePCA(df)
  assign(obj_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

#plotting
pseudobulk_pca_plots <- function(expr_data, metadata, sample_id_col, color_columns, plotTitle) {

  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[[sample_id_col]]

  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(expr_data), rownames(metadata))
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop("No matching samples found between expression data and metadata.")
  }
  expr_data <- expr_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  metadata <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  data_to_pca <- log2(expr_data + 1) 

  gene_sds <- apply(data_to_pca, 2, sd)
  data_to_pca <- data_to_pca[, gene_sds > 0, drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(data_to_pca) == 0) {
    stop("No genes remaining after removing zero-variance genes.")
  }

  pca_res <- prcomp(data_to_pca, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
  pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)
  pca_df <- cbind(pca_df, metadata)

  plot_list <- list()
  for (col in color_columns) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(metadata)) {
      warning(paste("Metadata column", col, "not found. Skipping."))
      next
    }

    p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes_string(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = col)) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = plotTitle,
           x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
    
    print(p)
    plot_list[[col]] <- p
  }

  invisible(plot_list)
}


pcaPlot <- function(expr_data, metadata, sample_id_col, color_columns, plotTitle) {
  # Match samples
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[[sample_id_col]]
  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(expr_data), rownames(metadata))
  expr_data <- expr_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  metadata <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]


  lib_size <- rowSums(expr_data)

    expr_data <- log2(expr_data + 1)

  # Remove zero-variance genes
  gene_sds <- apply(expr_data, 2, sd)
  expr_data <- expr_data[, gene_sds > 0, drop = FALSE]

  # PCA
  pca_res <- prcomp(expr_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
  pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)
  pca_df$lib_size <- lib_size[rownames(pca_df)]

  # Add metadata
  pca_df <- cbind(pca_df, metadata[rownames(pca_df), , drop = FALSE])

  # Generate plots for each color column
  plots <- lapply(color_columns, function(col) {
    is_continuous <- is.numeric(pca_df[[col]])
    p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(color = col,
           x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
    if (is_continuous) {
      p <- p + scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    return(p)
  })

  # Combine all plots into one image
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots) + 
    plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = plotTitle)

  return(lplot = combined_plot)
  
}

```
